sha_binding.verified_source_note: Design-only lane (spec-first, matching this repo's existing precedent for this class of change). No code, workflow, or hook file is modified. This is a CLEAN CONTINUATION branch cut from current main: PR #1289 exhausted the T1 CHANGES_REQUIRED bounce limit (4 authorized verdicts; merge-gate-verdict.cjs trips at >= 3), which the protected-base Merge Gate rejects regardless of any later APPROVED verdict. The objective was not failed -- only that execution attempt was -- so the reviewed design content is carried forward byte-for-byte and the mechanical findings are fixed here. NO SHA from the predecessor branch is inherited: every lineage field was cleared and rebound to this branch's own ancestry, verified with git merge-base --is-ancestor (literal output in verification.md). Binding is populated in the trailing evidence-rebind commit, since a commit cannot embed its own hash.

verifier.note: Genuinely distinct from manifest.created_by ("claude"): GitHub's Codex automated-review bot independently reviewed two exact heads on the PREDECESSOR branch (PR #1289), catching one real finding each time -- a proof-SHA-ancestry concern and a self-verification loophole in this very field, both since addressed. Those reviews are recorded as history, NOT carried forward as authority: they were bound to heads that do not exist in this branch's ancestry, so this continuation requires a FRESH independent exact-head review. Independent review is in any case explicitly NOT a substitute for this repo's T1 closure authority: the t1-approved label and a Griff-authored pm-verdict/v1 APPROVED comment remain separately required before merge, and neither exists on this head. independent_owner_certifier stays false because Codex is not the human PM owner-certifier T1 policy requires.

Per PM verdict, a concrete, T1-tier, dispatch-ready blocking implementation child issue has been created and linked -- see diff-summary.md for its ID and acceptance criteria. This lane does not close the named loopholes; it is design + a PM-sanctioned deferred implementation via that linked child.

The mechanical tier-classifier blocking-phase cutover and its prerequisite baseline/sweep report are explicitly out of scope for this lane -- both require their own separate PM approval per the locked MECHANICAL_TIER_CLASSIFIER_SPEC.md.

The corrected PreToolUse notice mechanism (hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext + systemMessage on exit 0) is verified against the official Claude Code hooks reference and in-repo precedent from other (non-PreToolUse) hooks already using the systemMessage pattern, but was not empirically instrumented against a live PreToolUse invocation from within this design-only lane -- confidence is HIGH, not certain. diff-summary.md now requires the implementation lane (UTV2-1570) to ship an integration test or captured behavior proof of the actual PreToolUse payload surfacing, rather than relying on this design's confidence level as sufficient proof on its own.
